Plan conflicts resolved in roofs.mjs, which the planner should note in plan.md ROOFS: (a) gin fascia removed (edges.fascia false) because it sits at x -1; (b) forge shed eave course moved y5 -> y6 because the head beam at y5 z9 is the shell's; (c) cloakroom roof is z 9..11 with no south overhang, dying into the classroom wall at z 12; (d) ell roof is z 15..17 with no north overhang, dying into the body's back wall at z 14; (e) classroom back overhang is 0, so its eave stops at z 18 and the grid stays 19 deep.

Off-palette swaps chosen by family, not exact match: dark_oak -> mangrove stairs/slab (plot 2 mix), oak and stripped oak -> bamboo stairs/slab (plot 6), stripped spruce -> spruce stairs/slab, stripped dark oak -> waxed exposed cut copper stairs/slab (barn), polished andesite -> andesite stairs/slab, deepslate brick -> deepslate tile stairs/slab. Check these against the plan's look.
Owner flight warning 'nothing to step out onto at 86,6,9' is not from this part: shells plots 4-7 placed 0 blocks, so the upper floor does not exist yet.

waste.what: Worked out the palette swap for every derived stair and slab form by hand, plus which plot each came from.
waste.cost: about 15 mapping decisions and one Proxy wrapper written by hand

waste.what: Found the object-as-material bug in the cart lean-to (B.stairs(PALETTE_SLATE) produced '[object Object]_stairs').
waste.cost: one report line read and one grep
waste.tool: B.stairs / B.slab could throw when given a non-string material, so the error points at the call instead of a bogus block id.

waste.what: Tried per-side overhang changes for the cloakroom, farm body, ell and classroom one at a time, and found the forge eave clash by reading the report.
waste.tool: A plan check in runParts or mcd fit that lists roof eave cells touching shell cells (or leaving the plot/grid) before the part runs, with the plan's ROOFS eave value beside each.

companions.task: Decide the eave course and fascia where the roof meets a beam or a wall: the forge head beam at y5, the gin's fascia, and whether the plan's eave heights are right at all.

Check the junctions: the cloakroom into the classroom wall, the farmhouse ell into the body's back wall, and the barn and owner flue passing the back roof slopes, then give the chimney part its keep boxes.
